reviews.title: NOT THE OFFICIAL STAYCONNECT APP!
reviews.text:
Note: this is not the official STAYCONNECT app.    I’ll also add that this app accomplishes “screen mirroring” by recording the screen and forwarding the recording as a stream to the tv.  Which is fine except many video apps such as Netflix block its screen content to be recorded for copyright reasons so they WILL NOT WORK with this app.  This is a technical design issue with this app and not an issue of wifi or weak network etc. 

Not worth the forced subscription upfront in my opinion.
